summary: Ongoing U.S.-Iran military strikes pushed oil above $80 and kept Treasury yields elevated near multi-month highs, hammering bonds while equities held firm on back-to-back soft inflation prints. Fed Chair Warsh's debut congressional testimony reinforced a data-dependent, hawkish-hold stance, keeping rate-hike risk alive and real rates firmly above average.
tweet: U.S.-Iran strikes lift oil, yields, and rate-hike odds — bonds take the hit while stocks shrug on cooling CPI and PPI.
